关于客厅的故事(A Story about the living room): 一篇关于家庭生活的A2短文:凯特与安娜的经历和小计划。
Last Friday, Kate and Anna went to the living room. Kate bought a coat at the shop yesterday. Kate wants to be a driver in the future. The best part of the trip was the food.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the living room by bike. Both of them like fish and juice. Kate likes cloudy days best. The hall holds two thousand people.
There are always many people at the family dinner. Kate learned a lot about math. Anna is interested in dancing. Best of all, she keeps a novel on the nightstand.
Kate and Anna had great fun there. They took many photos at the family dinner. Kate hopes to visit Paris one day.
